title: Talent Development Manager (f/m/d)
description:
Drive talent development for our headquarters.

What you'll do
- Design talent programmes and manage the learning budget
- Facilitate calibration sessions and development workshops
- Partner with HR business partners

What you bring
- 5+ years in talent or leadership development
- Strong facilitation experience
- Presence at our headquarters is mandatory; the team works on-site and does not offer remote working
